strategies.name: Sector Leader Swing
strategies.idea: Buy a short hourly dip in a strong stock inside a strong sector.
rules: Market: Turning up with Daily breadth under 85% (full size), or No clear turn (half size)
Swing Pullback, stage Ready, grade A, With trend
Not Extended (under 4 ranges above the 50 EMA)
Sector Leading or Improving, its index Daily Bullish, Wk bull 50% or more
strategies.exit: Hourly close above the entry level. Book half at the 2R target, trail the rest under hourly swing lows, exit by day 5 if it has not worked.

strategies.name: Weekly Overspill Positional
strategies.idea: Buy a long uptrend when the weekly chart dips into its 20-50 EMA zone and the Daily turns up.
rules: Market: anything except Still falling
Weekly Overspill, stage Ready, grade A, With trend
Sector not Lagging
Bonus (Equity): delivery higher than before
strategies.exit: Accordion: one third now, one third on a daily close above the entry level, the last third when Weekly momentum turns up. The stop is wide: size the first lot so it costs your normal risk. Trail under the weekly 20 EMA.

strategies.name: Breakout + Trend Overspill
strategies.idea: After a range breakout, buy the first hourly dips into the 20-50 EMA zone of the new trend.
rules: Market: anything except Still falling (half size when Overheated)
A Range breakout in the last 15 sessions that still holds (price above the old ceiling)
Weekly or Daily in Impulse
Hourly Overspill, stage Ready, Dip quality A
Not Extended (under 4 ranges above the Daily 50 EMA); sector not Lagging
strategies.exit: Hourly close above the entry (the hourly 20 EMA). Stop under the spill low. Book half at 2R, trail the rest under the hourly 50 EMA. Best on the first or second dip after the breakout; later dips are weaker.

strategies.name: Equity Base Breakout
strategies.idea: Buy a midcap or smallcap breaking out of a tight base on volume.
rules: Market (Equity): Turning up with Daily breadth under 85%
Breakout page: Ready (close to the level), grade A
RS 80 or more, base 20% deep or less, volume in the base below usual
Sector Leading or Improving, or not classified
strategies.exit: Daily close above the breakout level on volume at least 1.5x usual; no volume, no trade. Stop about one daily range below the level. Exit if it closes back inside the base within 3 days.
strategies.gate: Closed: Equity market is No clear turn
